faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Assistant position at Anna University?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Project Assistant position at Anna University is 14th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Assistant role will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Production, or Materials and Metallurgical Engineering, or an M.E./M.Tech/MS in related fields like Manufacturing or Production Engineering.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your filled application form and required documents to the specified email address before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the total number of vacancies for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Assistant position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves a written test and an interview, or an interview alone, as decided by the university.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. Where is Anna University located?
faq.answer: Anna University is located in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, with the pincode 600025.

faq.question: Q9. What is the nature of this job?
faq.answer: This is a project-based job, meaning the employment is tied to the duration and funding of the specific research project.

faq.question: Q10. Can I send my application by post?
faq.answer: While the primary application mode is email, the instructions also mention sending a filled-in application form with photocopies by post to a specific address. It is advisable to check the official notification for precise instructions.
